scenario.allocation_scope: Farm-task hours are prescribed within a three-worker upper envelope. More harvest staffing requires a real seasonal allocation change; hours are not banked from winter.

assumptions: 0.25ha is an approximate iugerum conversion; eight-hour workday is our unit-conversion scenario, not known Roman day length
Operation windows are manufactured and not inferred from climate or Columellas calendar
All availability is already allocated farm-task time, not total household time
Only listed field operations to the threshing floor: no threshing, processing, storage, water/fuel collection, care, draft animals feed or maintenance
Land is one complete annual crop activity per hectare; no automatic double cropping or fallow reconstruction
No observed yields, food adequacy, households, inequality or state formation are estimated
Matched annual-hours scenario changes seasonal farm staffing within a three-worker upper envelope; it does not store labour or establish feasibility of displaced nonfarm duties
